Being treated as the least priority mismo ng UNC hurts—deeply and personally. Hindi lang ito pakiramdam; ipinaparamdam sa araw-araw na parang second-class lang kami. Parang laging optional ang School of Teacher Education—laging nasa huli pagdating sa suporta, resources, at boses sa mga desisyon.

What makes it painful is this: I chose to serve this institution through education. I give my time, my competence, my passion, and my belief that forming teachers matters. Pero paulit-ulit mong mararamdaman na sa mata ng unibersidad, hindi ka ganun kaimportante. Mataas ang inaasahan—accreditation, compliance, results, board performance—pero kapag support na ang usapan, biglang tahimik.

Nakakapanghina ng loob na ang kolehiyong naghuhubog ng mga guro—na magtuturo sa libo-libong estudyante sa hinaharap—ay siya pang hindi binibigyan ng sapat na halaga. Para bang sinasabi ng UNC: kayanin niyo na lang, sanay naman kayo, resilient naman kayo.

Pero tao rin kami. Napapagod din. Nasasaktan din.

Hindi ito rant para sa entitlement. Ito ay sigaw para sa dignidad. Para sa respeto. Para sa pagkilalang ang Teacher Education ay hindi appendage lang ng unibersidad, kundi pundasyon nito.

Minsan, masakit tanggapin na kahit mahal mo ang isang institusyon, hindi niya kayang mahalin ka pabalik sa parehong paraan.

Concern Regarding Overnight Stay Policy for BRAPS (Psychology)

I would like to respectfully raise a concern regarding the policy that does not allow students to stay overnight with acquaintances from Iriga during the BRAPS event. I am from Iriga and will be participating in BRAPS. My parents are fully aware of the situation and have already given their consent for my friends to stay at our residence. They have also agreed to take full responsibility should any issues arise during the stay.
I am concerned about the instruction for students to return home after the event, which is expected to end around 9:00 PM. Traveling from Naga to Iriga at that hour raises serious safety and logistical concerns. The primary reason for arranging an overnight stay is that many students live far from UNC. While escorts may be provided, it is unclear whether students will be accompanied all the way to their respective homes or only until they reach UNC. At that time of night, transportation is very limited, especially for those residing in distant areas of Naga, and not all students are housed in dormitories near the university.
Furthermore, the second day of the event begins at 7:00 AM. If students arrive home close to midnight and are required to return early the following morning, this may pose difficulties in terms of rest, safety, and transportation. Students living in remote areas of Naga may struggle to find available transportation early in the morning to reach UNC in time, particularly since not all students have access to private transport or service vehicles.

In light of these concerns, I respectfully request that the policy be reconsidered, especially for students whose parents have provided explicit permission and are willing to assume responsibility. Allowing supervised and consented overnight stays may help ensure the safety, well-being, and active participation of students throughout the event.

[REPOST and RANT about GFW ADMIN who needs to exercise more critical thinking in attaining the actual good, not just exercise gaining reactions and attention to posts]

It is unfortunate that the admins of the Greyhound Freedom Wall do not have any actual power or capacity to help students who express suicidal ideation. In fact, posting these submissions can worsen the situation for someone who needs real support. For anyone to be helped, their identity needs to be known; this is sensitive work, and people who truly want to help must understand that it requires confidentiality, not public visibility masked by anonymity.

Thinking that posting an anonymous cry for help is “help” is misleading. It does not support the person; IT PROLIFERATES HARM and creates unnecessary damage by giving a false sense of hope that something meaningful is being done. It is difficult to accept, but help cannot be given to an unknown person.

I understand that submissions here are anonymous. But I ask the admins to also understand the other side: anonymity means that no real intervention can ever happen. At the very least, pages and posts like these must carry a clear DISCLAIMER that their platform (this FW) CANNOT PROVIDE HELP FOR SUICIDAL OR CRISIS-RELATED CONCERN.

I hope an admin posts this as well, so the rest of the team can seriously reflect on their responsibility and stop posting submissions that require professional and confidential support. Doing the right things right matters, especially when safety is at stake.

Admin 001: Sorry, bawi kami next time or take down na namin sooner or later itong GFW for good.

[rant and question]

Hii, long rant lang po. Wala kasi akong masabihan. Lately, ever since the holidays ended, I’ve been feeling overwhelmed. Kaka-overthink gabi-gabi, umaabot na sa point na hindi na ako nakakatulog nang maayos. Alam niyo po yung feeling na in-off mo na yung phone mo, tinabi mo na, pumikit ka na, pero hindi ka pa rin makatulog? Tapos parang hindi normal yung heartbeat mo, like hindi ka makatulog dahil sa kabog sa dibdib mo. Basta may na fe-feel akong takot, natatakot ako hindi ko alam kung saan.

Hindi naman po ako ganito dati, ngayon kung ano-ano na iniisip ko, kung kaya ko ba ’tong course na ’to, kung mabibigay ko ba sa parents ko yung life na gusto ko para sa kanila. Napakahirap.

Kanina, hindi ako nakapasok kasi nakatulog ako ng 5am., eh 8am. yung pasok ko. Pero 12am. pa lang, nakapikit na ako. Pinipilit ko na yung utak ko matulog, pero hindi talaga ako makatulog. I even cried and knelt on the floor, praying to Him, asking Him what’s happening to me, kasi hindi naman ako ganito dati. Okay naman ako noon ever since holidays ended ewan ko something died in me parang lagi akong kulang.

Now I’m writing this and I feel something in my throat, parang may nakabara and I know damn well something’s really wrong with me. I find it hard to open up to my parents and to my friends because they know me as a happy person kalog na kalog ganon. Parang ang weird diba kapag bigla nilang nalaman na hindi na oala ako okay. Pero pag sa umaga naman pag kasama ko friends ko, okay naman ako puro pa nga tawa eh, sa gabi lang talaga sobrang bigat.

Please help me. Where do I run? Ayaw ko naman magpa-therapy or mag-consult sa mental health professionals kasi dagdag gastos lang ’yun, especially ang mahal ng tuition ko. First year pa lang ako.

I decided to open it here para kahit pano mabawasan ang bigat wala ngani ako masabihan, ayaw ko na ng ganito naapektohan na pag aaral ko.
